bugs: List/detail read project.intake_view with a bare attribute access on a Project.objects.get result (views/intake.py:71,241): missing project -> Project.DoesNotExist -> 404 mapping, never the empty-queryset path. Port as-is.
Detail retrieve uses .get(issue_id=issue_id) on the snoozed-filtered queryset (views/intake.py:277): a snoozed-out row raises IntakeIssue.DoesNotExist -> 404 mapping (not an empty 200). Port as-is.

result_rows.guard_on: intake rows for (workspace slug, project, intake) with (snoozed_till >= now OR snoozed_till IS NULL), issue+workspace+project joined

list_detail_queryset.rule: intake = Intake.filter(workspace__slug, project_id).first(); project = Project.get(workspace__slug, pk); if intake is None or not project.intake_view -> .none(). Else IntakeIssue.filter((snoozed Q), workspace__slug, project_id, intake_id).select_related(issue, workspace, project).order_by(kwargs.get('order_by', '-created_at')). Identical in list (views/intake.py:63-83) and detail (:233-253).
sql: SELECT <intakes cols> FROM "intakes" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON (...) WHERE ("intakes"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."slug" = %s AND "intakes"."project_id" = %s) ORDER BY "intakes"."name" ASC LIMIT 1;  -- .first(), Meta.ordering (name)

SELECT <intake_issues cols> + <issue cols> + <workspace cols> + <project cols> FROM "intake_issues" LEFT OUTER JOIN "issues" ... INNER JOIN "workspaces" ... WHERE ("intake_issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND ("intake_issues"."snoozed_till" >= %s OR "intake_issues"."snoozed_till" IS NULL) AND "workspaces"."slug" = %s AND "intake_issues"."project_id" = %s AND "intake_issues"."intake_id" = %s) ORDER BY "intake_issues"."created_at" DESC;  -- default order_by -created_at; select_related = joins, no extra queries

patch_issue_annotations.rule: Issue.objects.annotate(label_ids=Coalesce(ArrayAgg(labels__id, distinct, filter=~null & label_issue.deleted null), []), assignee_ids=Coalesce(ArrayAgg(assignees__id, distinct, filter=~null & member active & issue_assignee.deleted null), [])).get(pk=issue_id, workspace__slug, project_id). Guards: labels drop deleted links only (no active check); assignees drop inactive members AND deleted links.
patch_issue_annotations.sql: SELECT <issues cols>, COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT "labels"."id") FILTER (WHERE (NOT ("labels"."id" IS NULL) AND "label_issue"."deleted_at" IS NULL)), '{}'), COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT "assignees"."id") FILTER (WHERE (NOT ("assignees"."id" IS NULL) AND "project_members"."is_active" AND "issue_assignee"."deleted_at" IS NULL)), '{}') FROM "issues" ... WHERE ("issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "issues"."id" = %s AND "workspaces"."slug" = %s AND "issues"."project_id" = %s) GROUP BY "issues"."id";

triage_get_or_create.rule: State.triage_objects.filter(project_id, workspace__slug).first() (manager restricts group='triage', state.py:86-90); if None -> State.objects.create(name='Triage', group='triage', project_id, workspace_id, color='#4E5355', sequence=65000, default=False). sql: SELECT <states cols> FROM "states" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON (...) WHERE ("states"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "states"."group" = 'triage' AND "states"."project_id" = %s AND "workspaces"."slug" = %s) ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1;
